title: Microsoft Teams: express face enrollment from meeting video for Teams Rooms recognition
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned express face enrollment feature from documented enrollment and room-recognition controls. The room-recognition portal path stops just before the Face Recognition setting and should include that final step.

claims.quote: EnrollFace | Allows users to manually create and manage their face profiles via their Recognition settings for facial identification in meetings using supported cameras.
